column6: Share of Emerging AI within Low-exposure Occupations
column9: The AI Adoption Index (AIAX) measures the prevalence of emerging AI skills in online job postings across economies and occupations. The dataset contains monthly economy-level indicators for 110 economies from January 2023 to April 2026 and occupation-level indicators based on postings from May 2025 to April 2026.
column10: Sakai Ando, Divya Kirti, Willa Lin, Assyifa Szami Ilman
column25: The AI Adoption Index (AIAX) is constructed using online job posting data from Lightcast. Lightcast aggregates vacancy information from online job boards, employer career websites, and other web-based recruitment sources and standardizes occupations, skills, industries, and locations across economies. The index measures the prevalence of emerging AI skills in labor demand and is calculated as the share of job postings that contain at least one emerging AI skill. Emerging AI skills are identified using a taxonomy developed by IMF staff based on Lightcast skill classifications and related AI-skill taxonomies (Ando and others, 2026). Monthly economy-level indicators are compiled for 110 economies from January 2023 to April 2026. Occupation-level indicators are compiled for 340 ISCO-08 four-digit occupations and are based on the average share of postings requiring emerging AI skills during May 2025-April 2026.

Lightcast aggregates vacancy information from online job boards, employer career websites, and other web-based recruitment sources and standardizes occupations, skills, industries, and locations across economies. The index measures the prevalence of emerging AI skills in labor demand and is calculated as the share of job postings that contain at least one emerging AI skill. Emerging AI skills are identified using a taxonomy developed by IMF staff based on Lightcast skill classifications and related AI-skill taxonomies (Ando and others, 2026). Monthly economy-level indicators are compiled for 110 economies from January 2023 to April 2026. Occupation-level indicators are compiled for 340 ISCO-08 four-digit occupations and are based on the average share of postings requiring emerging AI skills during May 2025-April 2026.

The index measures the prevalence of emerging AI skills in labor demand and is calculated as the share of job postings that contain at least one emerging AI skill. Emerging AI skills are identified using a taxonomy developed by IMF staff based on Lightcast skill classifications and related AI-skill taxonomies (Ando and others, 2026). Monthly economy-level indicators are compiled for 110 economies from January 2023 to April 2026. Occupation-level indicators are compiled for 340 ISCO-08 four-digit occupations and are based on the average share of postings requiring emerging AI skills during May 2025-April 2026.

column10: Sakai Ando, Divya Kirti, Willa Lin, Assyifa Szami Ilman
column25: The AI Adoption Index (AIAX) is constructed using online job posting data from Lightcast. Lightcast aggregates vacancy information from online job boards, employer career websites, and other web-based recruitment sources and standardizes occupations, skills, industries, and locations across economies. The index measures the prevalence of emerging AI skills in labor demand and is calculated as the share of job postings that contain at least one emerging AI skill. Emerging AI skills are identified using a taxonomy developed by IMF staff based on Lightcast skill classifications and related AI-skill taxonomies (Ando and others, 2026). Monthly economy-level indicators are compiled for 110 economies from January 2023 to April 2026. Occupation-level indicators are compiled for 340 ISCO-08 four-digit occupations and are based on the average share of postings requiring emerging AI skills during May 2025-April 2026.

column10: Sakai Ando, Divya Kirti, Willa Lin, Assyifa Szami Ilman
column25: The AI Adoption Index (AIAX) is constructed using online job posting data from Lightcast. Lightcast aggregates vacancy information from online job boards, employer career websites, and other web-based recruitment sources and standardizes occupations, skills, industries, and locations across economies. The index measures the prevalence of emerging AI skills in labor demand and is calculated as the share of job postings that contain at least one emerging AI skill. Emerging AI skills are identified using a taxonomy developed by IMF staff based on Lightcast skill classifications and related AI-skill taxonomies (Ando and others, 2026). Monthly economy-level indicators are compiled for 110 economies from January 2023 to April 2026. Occupation-level indicators are compiled for 340 ISCO-08 four-digit occupations and are based on the average share of postings requiring emerging AI skills during May 2025-April 2026.

The index measures the prevalence of emerging AI skills in labor demand and is calculated as the share of job postings that contain at least one emerging AI skill. Emerging AI skills are identified using a taxonomy developed by IMF staff based on Lightcast skill classifications and related AI-skill taxonomies (Ando and others, 2026). Monthly economy-level indicators are compiled for 110 economies from January 2023 to April 2026. Occupation-level indicators are compiled for 340 ISCO-08 four-digit occupations and are based on the average share of postings requiring emerging AI skills during May 2025-April 2026.

column10: Sakai Ando, Divya Kirti, Willa Lin, Assyifa Szami Ilman
column25: The AI Adoption Index (AIAX) is constructed using online job posting data from Lightcast. Lightcast aggregates vacancy information from online job boards, employer career websites, and other web-based recruitment sources and standardizes occupations, skills, industries, and locations across economies. The index measures the prevalence of emerging AI skills in labor demand and is calculated as the share of job postings that contain at least one emerging AI skill. Emerging AI skills are identified using a taxonomy developed by IMF staff based on Lightcast skill classifications and related AI-skill taxonomies (Ando and others, 2026). Monthly economy-level indicators are compiled for 110 economies from January 2023 to April 2026. Occupation-level indicators are compiled for 340 ISCO-08 four-digit occupations and are based on the average share of postings requiring emerging AI skills during May 2025-April 2026.

column10: Sakai Ando, Divya Kirti, Willa Lin, Assyifa Szami Ilman
column25: The AI Adoption Index (AIAX) is constructed using online job posting data from Lightcast. Lightcast aggregates vacancy information from online job boards, employer career websites, and other web-based recruitment sources and standardizes occupations, skills, industries, and locations across economies. The index measures the prevalence of emerging AI skills in labor demand and is calculated as the share of job postings that contain at least one emerging AI skill. Emerging AI skills are identified using a taxonomy developed by IMF staff based on Lightcast skill classifications and related AI-skill taxonomies (Ando and others, 2026). Monthly economy-level indicators are compiled for 110 economies from January 2023 to April 2026. Occupation-level indicators are compiled for 340 ISCO-08 four-digit occupations and are based on the average share of postings requiring emerging AI skills during May 2025-April 2026.

Lightcast aggregates vacancy information from online job boards, employer career websites, and other web-based recruitment sources and standardizes occupations, skills, industries, and locations across economies. The index measures the prevalence of emerging AI skills in labor demand and is calculated as the share of job postings that contain at least one emerging AI skill. Emerging AI skills are identified using a taxonomy developed by IMF staff based on Lightcast skill classifications and related AI-skill taxonomies (Ando and others, 2026). Monthly economy-level indicators are compiled for 110 economies from January 2023 to April 2026. Occupation-level indicators are compiled for 340 ISCO-08 four-digit occupations and are based on the average share of postings requiring emerging AI skills during May 2025-April 2026.

The index measures the prevalence of emerging AI skills in labor demand and is calculated as the share of job postings that contain at least one emerging AI skill. Emerging AI skills are identified using a taxonomy developed by IMF staff based on Lightcast skill classifications and related AI-skill taxonomies (Ando and others, 2026). Monthly economy-level indicators are compiled for 110 economies from January 2023 to April 2026. Occupation-level indicators are compiled for 340 ISCO-08 four-digit occupations and are based on the average share of postings requiring emerging AI skills during May 2025-April 2026.

The index measures the prevalence of emerging AI skills in labor demand and is calculated as the share of job postings that contain at least one emerging AI skill. Emerging AI skills are identified using a taxonomy developed by IMF staff based on Lightcast skill classifications and related AI-skill taxonomies (Ando and others, 2026). Monthly economy-level indicators are compiled for 110 economies from January 2023 to April 2026. Occupation-level indicators are compiled for 340 ISCO-08 four-digit occupations and are based on the average share of postings requiring emerging AI skills during May 2025-April 2026.

column10: Sakai Ando, Divya Kirti, Willa Lin, Assyifa Szami Ilman
column25: The AI Adoption Index (AIAX) is constructed using online job posting data from Lightcast. Lightcast aggregates vacancy information from online job boards, employer career websites, and other web-based recruitment sources and standardizes occupations, skills, industries, and locations across economies. The index measures the prevalence of emerging AI skills in labor demand and is calculated as the share of job postings that contain at least one emerging AI skill. Emerging AI skills are identified using a taxonomy developed by IMF staff based on Lightcast skill classifications and related AI-skill taxonomies (Ando and others, 2026). Monthly economy-level indicators are compiled for 110 economies from January 2023 to April 2026. Occupation-level indicators are compiled for 340 ISCO-08 four-digit occupations and are based on the average share of postings requiring emerging AI skills during May 2025-April 2026.

column25: The AI Adoption Index (AIAX) is constructed using online job posting data from Lightcast. Lightcast aggregates vacancy information from online job boards, employer career websites, and other web-based recruitment sources and standardizes occupations, skills, industries, and locations across economies. The index measures the prevalence of emerging AI skills in labor demand and is calculated as the share of job postings that contain at least one emerging AI skill. Emerging AI skills are identified using a taxonomy developed by IMF staff based on Lightcast skill classifications and related AI-skill taxonomies (Ando and others, 2026). Monthly economy-level indicators are compiled for 110 economies from January 2023 to April 2026. Occupation-level indicators are compiled for 340 ISCO-08 four-digit occupations and are based on the average share of postings requiring emerging AI skills during May 2025-April 2026.

Lightcast aggregates vacancy information from online job boards, employer career websites, and other web-based recruitment sources and standardizes occupations, skills, industries, and locations across economies. The index measures the prevalence of emerging AI skills in labor demand and is calculated as the share of job postings that contain at least one emerging AI skill. Emerging AI skills are identified using a taxonomy developed by IMF staff based on Lightcast skill classifications and related AI-skill taxonomies (Ando and others, 2026). Monthly economy-level indicators are compiled for 110 economies from January 2023 to April 2026. Occupation-level indicators are compiled for 340 ISCO-08 four-digit occupations and are based on the average share of postings requiring emerging AI skills during May 2025-April 2026.

Lightcast aggregates vacancy information from online job boards, employer career websites, and other web-based recruitment sources and standardizes occupations, skills, industries, and locations across economies. The index measures the prevalence of emerging AI skills in labor demand and is calculated as the share of job postings that contain at least one emerging AI skill. Emerging AI skills are identified using a taxonomy developed by IMF staff based on Lightcast skill classifications and related AI-skill taxonomies (Ando and others, 2026). Monthly economy-level indicators are compiled for 110 economies from January 2023 to April 2026. Occupation-level indicators are compiled for 340 ISCO-08 four-digit occupations and are based on the average share of postings requiring emerging AI skills during May 2025-April 2026.

column10: Sakai Ando, Divya Kirti, Willa Lin, Assyifa Szami Ilman
column25: The AI Adoption Index (AIAX) is constructed using online job posting data from Lightcast. Lightcast aggregates vacancy information from online job boards, employer career websites, and other web-based recruitment sources and standardizes occupations, skills, industries, and locations across economies. The index measures the prevalence of emerging AI skills in labor demand and is calculated as the share of job postings that contain at least one emerging AI skill. Emerging AI skills are identified using a taxonomy developed by IMF staff based on Lightcast skill classifications and related AI-skill taxonomies (Ando and others, 2026). Monthly economy-level indicators are compiled for 110 economies from January 2023 to April 2026. Occupation-level indicators are compiled for 340 ISCO-08 four-digit occupations and are based on the average share of postings requiring emerging AI skills during May 2025-April 2026.

The index measures the prevalence of emerging AI skills in labor demand and is calculated as the share of job postings that contain at least one emerging AI skill. Emerging AI skills are identified using a taxonomy developed by IMF staff based on Lightcast skill classifications and related AI-skill taxonomies (Ando and others, 2026). Monthly economy-level indicators are compiled for 110 economies from January 2023 to April 2026. Occupation-level indicators are compiled for 340 ISCO-08 four-digit occupations and are based on the average share of postings requiring emerging AI skills during May 2025-April 2026.

column10: Sakai Ando, Divya Kirti, Willa Lin, Assyifa Szami Ilman
column25: The AI Adoption Index (AIAX) is constructed using online job posting data from Lightcast. Lightcast aggregates vacancy information from online job boards, employer career websites, and other web-based recruitment sources and standardizes occupations, skills, industries, and locations across economies. The index measures the prevalence of emerging AI skills in labor demand and is calculated as the share of job postings that contain at least one emerging AI skill. Emerging AI skills are identified using a taxonomy developed by IMF staff based on Lightcast skill classifications and related AI-skill taxonomies (Ando and others, 2026). Monthly economy-level indicators are compiled for 110 economies from January 2023 to April 2026. Occupation-level indicators are compiled for 340 ISCO-08 four-digit occupations and are based on the average share of postings requiring emerging AI skills during May 2025-April 2026.

Lightcast aggregates vacancy information from online job boards, employer career websites, and other web-based recruitment sources and standardizes occupations, skills, industries, and locations across economies. The index measures the prevalence of emerging AI skills in labor demand and is calculated as the share of job postings that contain at least one emerging AI skill. Emerging AI skills are identified using a taxonomy developed by IMF staff based on Lightcast skill classifications and related AI-skill taxonomies (Ando and others, 2026). Monthly economy-level indicators are compiled for 110 economies from January 2023 to April 2026. Occupation-level indicators are compiled for 340 ISCO-08 four-digit occupations and are based on the average share of postings requiring emerging AI skills during May 2025-April 2026.

The index measures the prevalence of emerging AI skills in labor demand and is calculated as the share of job postings that contain at least one emerging AI skill. Emerging AI skills are identified using a taxonomy developed by IMF staff based on Lightcast skill classifications and related AI-skill taxonomies (Ando and others, 2026). Monthly economy-level indicators are compiled for 110 economies from January 2023 to April 2026. Occupation-level indicators are compiled for 340 ISCO-08 four-digit occupations and are based on the average share of postings requiring emerging AI skills during May 2025-April 2026.

The index measures the prevalence of emerging AI skills in labor demand and is calculated as the share of job postings that contain at least one emerging AI skill. Emerging AI skills are identified using a taxonomy developed by IMF staff based on Lightcast skill classifications and related AI-skill taxonomies (Ando and others, 2026). Monthly economy-level indicators are compiled for 110 economies from January 2023 to April 2026. Occupation-level indicators are compiled for 340 ISCO-08 four-digit occupations and are based on the average share of postings requiring emerging AI skills during May 2025-April 2026.

column10: Sakai Ando, Divya Kirti, Willa Lin, Assyifa Szami Ilman
column25: The AI Adoption Index (AIAX) is constructed using online job posting data from Lightcast. Lightcast aggregates vacancy information from online job boards, employer career websites, and other web-based recruitment sources and standardizes occupations, skills, industries, and locations across economies. The index measures the prevalence of emerging AI skills in labor demand and is calculated as the share of job postings that contain at least one emerging AI skill. Emerging AI skills are identified using a taxonomy developed by IMF staff based on Lightcast skill classifications and related AI-skill taxonomies (Ando and others, 2026). Monthly economy-level indicators are compiled for 110 economies from January 2023 to April 2026. Occupation-level indicators are compiled for 340 ISCO-08 four-digit occupations and are based on the average share of postings requiring emerging AI skills during May 2025-April 2026.

Lightcast aggregates vacancy information from online job boards, employer career websites, and other web-based recruitment sources and standardizes occupations, skills, industries, and locations across economies. The index measures the prevalence of emerging AI skills in labor demand and is calculated as the share of job postings that contain at least one emerging AI skill. Emerging AI skills are identified using a taxonomy developed by IMF staff based on Lightcast skill classifications and related AI-skill taxonomies (Ando and others, 2026). Monthly economy-level indicators are compiled for 110 economies from January 2023 to April 2026. Occupation-level indicators are compiled for 340 ISCO-08 four-digit occupations and are based on the average share of postings requiring emerging AI skills during May 2025-April 2026.

The index measures the prevalence of emerging AI skills in labor demand and is calculated as the share of job postings that contain at least one emerging AI skill. Emerging AI skills are identified using a taxonomy developed by IMF staff based on Lightcast skill classifications and related AI-skill taxonomies (Ando and others, 2026). Monthly economy-level indicators are compiled for 110 economies from January 2023 to April 2026. Occupation-level indicators are compiled for 340 ISCO-08 four-digit occupations and are based on the average share of postings requiring emerging AI skills during May 2025-April 2026.

The index measures the prevalence of emerging AI skills in labor demand and is calculated as the share of job postings that contain at least one emerging AI skill. Emerging AI skills are identified using a taxonomy developed by IMF staff based on Lightcast skill classifications and related AI-skill taxonomies (Ando and others, 2026). Monthly economy-level indicators are compiled for 110 economies from January 2023 to April 2026. Occupation-level indicators are compiled for 340 ISCO-08 four-digit occupations and are based on the average share of postings requiring emerging AI skills during May 2025-April 2026.

column10: Sakai Ando, Divya Kirti, Willa Lin, Assyifa Szami Ilman
column25: The AI Adoption Index (AIAX) is constructed using online job posting data from Lightcast. Lightcast aggregates vacancy information from online job boards, employer career websites, and other web-based recruitment sources and standardizes occupations, skills, industries, and locations across economies. The index measures the prevalence of emerging AI skills in labor demand and is calculated as the share of job postings that contain at least one emerging AI skill. Emerging AI skills are identified using a taxonomy developed by IMF staff based on Lightcast skill classifications and related AI-skill taxonomies (Ando and others, 2026). Monthly economy-level indicators are compiled for 110 economies from January 2023 to April 2026. Occupation-level indicators are compiled for 340 ISCO-08 four-digit occupations and are based on the average share of postings requiring emerging AI skills during May 2025-April 2026.
